name: rpncalc-web
description: Precision Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) Scientific & Engineering Calculator (Web & Capacitor Native iOS/Android/macOS)

scripts.build:www: mkdir -p www && cp index.html styles.css app.js calculator.js manifest.json sw.js icon.svg favicon.ico www/
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "RPN Calculator" com.karlkue.rpncalc --web-dir www
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync

author: Karl Kue
